page.notes: Line numbers 10 to 60 in the gutter were treated as marginal numbers beside the two columns and placed as notes, with approximate positions. Several passages in the upper and middle part of the page are small and only partly legible; the transcription follows the scan as far as it can be read. The left page ends in mid-sentence ("Rerum in Anglia a") and continues on the right page. The final entry on the right page is cut off at the foot of the scan. The page number 606 is read from the printed "6o6".
